text: My neighbor asked whether I could water her plants next week.
Someone at the bus stop asked me what time it was.
A coworker left a note asking where the stapler went.
My cousin wants to know how to get to the train station.
The new tenant asked which day the bins are collected.
A stranger asked if this seat was taken.
My brother asked to borrow a ladder on Saturday.
The intern asked how to book a meeting room.
A customer asked whether the shop opens on Sundays.
My friend asked what to bring to dinner.
A classmate asked for the page numbers of the homework.
The delivery driver asked which door to use.
